# Rendering Release Gates Checklist: Conversational Voice Map Assistant

**Purpose**: Assess whether the release requirements completely and measurably define the minimum safeguards for visible background and highlighted 3D buildings, complete published geometry, and browser render failures.
**Created**: 2026-07-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements defined for simultaneous visibility of at least one background building and one highlighted building in a deterministic supported map view? [Gap, Constitution VI]
- [x] CHK002 Are the fixture, camera, viewport, zoom, pitch, and bearing required for the rendering release gate explicitly documented? [Gap]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for complete accounting of every content URI reachable from the published background tileset manifest? [Gap, Constitution I]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for remote byte length and digest parity against the approved local geometry object for every published content URI? [Gap, Constitution I]
- [x] CHK005 Is the expected treatment of intentionally empty B3DM nodes specified, including whether their manifest nodes may retain a `content` reference? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is “visible building” quantified independently for background and highlighted geometry using objective screen-space or pixel-difference criteria? [Ambiguity]
- [x] CHK007 Are the browser errors that invalidate rendering explicitly enumerated, including page exceptions, unexpected console errors, Deck.gl, WebGL, B3DM, and HTML asset fallbacks? [Gap]
- [x] CHK008 Is the distinction between successful tile selection/loading and successful drawable sublayer creation explicitly stated? [Gap]
- [x] CHK009 Is the allowable set of ignored third-party browser messages narrowly and explicitly defined? [Gap, Exception Flow]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Are rendering release requirements consistent with the existing requirement to restore full visual quality after movement optimization? [Consistency, Constitution VI]
- [x] CHK011 Are the background-release requirements consistent with atomic publication and preservation of the previous approved release when verification is incomplete? [Consistency, Constitution III]
- [x] CHK012 Is the proposed combined visibility gate explicitly distinguished from existing identity-separation, camera-synchronization, and POI catalogue-parity requirements to avoid duplicate coverage? [Consistency, Constitution VII]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Can background visibility, highlighted visibility, and absence of rendering errors each fail independently with a diagnostic identifying the failed condition? [Measurability]
- [x] CHK014 Is complete inventory coverage measurable against the manifest content-reference count rather than a POI-derived subset or sample object? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap]
- [x] CHK015 Are required PR, pre-deployment, and post-deployment execution points explicitly assigned to the appropriate rendering and asset-integrity gates? [Traceability, Gap]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are requirements defined for stale remote objects, missing remote objects, HTML fallbacks, zero-mesh B3DMs, and drawable tiles that coexist with one invalid selected tile? [Coverage, Exception Flow]
- [x] CHK017 Are intro-to-map camera motion and settled-view rendering both included without duplicating the existing movement-state assertions? [Coverage, Constitution VI]
- [x] CHK018 Is failure behavior specified so an unverifiable geometry release blocks publication and preserves the previous active release? [Recovery, Constitution III]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK019 Is the assumption that a stable non-highlighted building and a stable highlighted fixture remain within the chosen visual masks documented and controlled? [Assumption]
- [x] CHK020 Are the dependencies on the immutable snapshot, background release descriptor, R2 object metadata, and supported Chromium renderer explicitly documented? [Dependency, Gap]
